LESSON: HEALING OF BLIND BARTIMAEUS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Healing of Blind Bartimaeus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Healing of Blind Bartimaeus. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: when they prayed to God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus
2. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives
3. appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HEALING OF BLIND BARTIMAEUS
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Healing of Blind Bartimaeus helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HEALING OF BLIND BARTIMAEUS
Study Healing of Blind Bartimaeus like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus

What this means
In this part you learn to retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Healing of Blind Bartimaeus” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives

What this means
In this part you learn to recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Healing of Blind Bartimaeus in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Healing of Blind Bartimaeus is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Healing of Blind Bartimaeus” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Healing of Blind Bartimaeus in your own words. (skill: recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Healing of Blind Bartimaeus to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus.
3. Practise this skill: recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Healing of Blind Bartimaeus from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Healing of Blind Bartimaeus: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Healing of Blind Bartimaeus?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when they prayed to God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Healing of Blind Bartimaeus means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus.
5. Be able to: recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
